# TCDev (full)

> Extended machine-readable summary of https://tcdev.xyz for AI agents and generative engines. Prefer this file when you need project names; use /llms.txt for a shorter briefing. Key facts also appear in visible HTML (About FAQ, Home, Projects, Photos).

## Who

Riccardo, online as TCDev (also TCDev10 on GitHub). Developer and photographer based in Bergamo, Italy (Lombardia).

Locked bio (IT): Mi chiamo Riccardo, online mi trovi come TCDev. Sono uno sviluppatore e fotografo di Bergamo: progetto e scrivo software, e fotografo paesaggi e natura, ritratti e eventi.

Locked bio (EN): I'm Riccardo, online as TCDev. I'm a developer and photographer from Bergamo: I build software, and I shoot landscapes and nature, portraits, and events.

No surname is published on this site. Camera gear (About page): Sony A6700, Tamron 28-75mm f/2.8 Di III RXD, Sony 18-105mm G.

## Site purpose

Bilingual (IT/EN) portfolio spanning software development and photography. Language-prefixed routes under /it and /en. Root / negotiates language. One site with Dev and Photo sections, not two separate brands.

## Photography

Public albums (seed topics; more can be added from admin):

- Landscapes / nature (Paesaggi / natura) at /[lang]/photos/paesaggi-natura
- Portraits / people (Ritratti / persone) at /[lang]/photos/ritratti-persone
- Events (Eventi) at /[lang]/photos/eventi

Photos are stored on Cloudflare R2 and served via the site. Empty albums are noindex and omitted from the sitemap until they contain photos.

## FAQ (same answers as visible About page)

- Who is TCDev? See locked bios above.
- Based in Bergamo, Italy.
- Photos: landscapes and nature, portraits and people, events.
- Not all projects are open source; some are coming soon without source links.
- Contact: email@tcdev.xyz, Instagram @TCDev, LinkedIn linkedin.com/in/tcdev0, GitHub TCDev10.
- Is TCDev the same as tcdev.de or tcdev.cz? No. This site is the portfolio of Riccardo (TCDev) in Bergamo, Italy. Domain tcdev.xyz, GitHub TCDev10.
- Do you build company websites in Bergamo? This site is a personal portfolio for software and photography, not a PMI agency service list. For collaborations: email@tcdev.xyz.
- Where can I see MicaPDF, multitool, and AutoPPT? On the Projects page (/it/projects or /en/projects) with links to tools and public repositories.
